This is a transfer or move from ticket 0117377 to 0117401

it said that it was moved but it was not. the ticket notes were indeed removed from 0117377 but it was not added to 0117401
I could not reach the assistant, but your report is safe — press Submit when you are ready.

Sorry about that glitch — I have your report and I'm on it now.

To confirm what happened: in the **review** queue you moved a call's note from ticket 0117377 to 0117401, it reported success, the note was removed from the old ticket, but nothing landed on the new one.

Does this happen every time you move a note between tickets, or was this a one-off?

My best guess at this stage: the move appears to work in two steps — remove from the source ticket, then post to the target — and the second step failed silently (e.g. the HaloPSA API rejected the post to 0117401) with no rollback of the removal. Checking the **logs** tab for the HaloPSA action around that time would likely show the failed post.
this is the first time i've done this

Thanks — that's enough for me to file it clearly.

**My best read:** since this is your first move, it's likely a one-off failure on the HaloPSA side of the transfer — the service removed the note from 0117377, then the post to 0117401 failed (rejected by the API, ticket locked, or a transient error) without any rollback or visible error. The **logs** tab should show the Halo action for that move and may reveal why the second step failed. As a workaround, if the call is still in the **review** history, you should be able to open it, set the ticket to 0117401, and re-approve to re-post the note.

I have what I need — you can press Submit now, and feel free to add anything else first if I've misread anything.
i clicked on add more info, i cant submit again. i only got send button

No worries — that's expected: after adding more info, "Send" submits your report together with anything new you've added, so you're all set.

If that screenshot is of the **logs** tab showing the failed Halo post, that's exactly the kind of evidence that'll help whoever investigates — please include it with the send. Nothing more needed from me; press Send when ready.
i cant send without anything in the chatbox. should i just start over to close?

You don't need to start over — just type a short note like "no more info" in the chatbox and press Send; that will close it out with your report intact.

Your report is complete as-is, so nothing further is needed.
